h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ambattur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ambattur

items.pText: Ambattur grew up around one of Chennai's oldest industrial estates, and today factories, warehouses and apartment blocks share the same roads. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Ambattur to company campuses, staff housing, schools and residential complexes. Every piece is made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,040 km away, sent by road to Chennai and installed by our team or a local dealer.

Several companies in industrial areas like Ambattur now set aside space for employees' families, whether a crèche garden, a staff quarters park or a corner of the canteen lawn. These spaces are usually small and used by young children, so compact equipment for ages 3 to 8 works better than a tall tower. The climate is hot and humid for most of the year. Most of the rain falls during the northeast monsoon from October to December, when low-lying plots can hold water. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit these conditions.

items.q: What playground equipment suits a company crèche?
items.a: Low, compact pieces for ages 3 to 8, such as small multi play stations, spring riders, toddler swings and crawling tunnels. Keep the area fenced and away from vehicle movement.

items.q: How do we handle waterlogging during the northeast monsoon?
items.a: Raise the play area slightly above the surrounding ground, give it a gentle slope and lay rubber flooring. Grouted posts set in concrete stay firm even when the soil around is wet.

items.q: Can you deliver playground equipment to Ambattur?
items.a: Yes. We send it from our Vasai factory to Chennai by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer near you.
